Prior hyperparameters for the contamination-mixture model

Source: R/priors.R
mixture_prior.Rd

Collects the hyperparameters of all prior distributions used by mixture_fit() and baseline_fit(). The defaults are exactly those of the original research code, so that results are reproducible.

Usage

mixture_prior(
  beta_scale = 25,
  sigma_shape = 2,
  sigma_rate = 1,
  pi_shape1 = 1,
  pi_shape2 = 1,
  tau_shape = 2,
  tau_rate = 2,
  mu0_var = 100,
  q_shape1 = 1,
  q_shape2 = 1,
  lambda_shape = 1,
  lambda_rate = 1
)

Arguments

beta_scale

Prior variance \(b_0\) of each regression coefficient: \(\beta \sim N_p(0, b_0 I_p)\). Also used for the rival regression \(\beta_{bad}\) of model "M1".

sigma_shape, sigma_rate

Inverse-gamma prior for the Gaussian error variance, \(\sigma^2 \sim IG(a_\sigma, b_\sigma)\) (Gaussian family only; also used for the rival-regression variance in Gaussian "M1").

pi_shape1, pi_shape2

Beta prior for the probability \(\pi\) that a non-probability observation is compatible ("good"): \(\pi \sim Beta(a_\pi, b_\pi)\). The contamination fraction is \(1 - \pi\).

tau_shape, tau_rate

Inverse-gamma prior for the variance \(\tau^2\) of the covariate-free contaminating outcome density (Gaussian "M0" and "Mjoint").

mu0_var

Prior variance of the mean \(\mu_0\) of the contaminating outcome density (Gaussian "M0"/"Mjoint"). The prior mean is the sample mean of the non-probability outcomes (an empirical-Bayes choice inherited from the original code).

q_shape1, q_shape2

Beta prior for the base rate \(q\) of the contaminating Bernoulli density (binomial "M0"/"Mjoint").

lambda_shape, lambda_rate

Gamma prior (shape, rate) for the rate \(\lambda_0\) of the contaminating Poisson density (Poisson "M0"/"Mjoint").

Value

An object of class bsm_prior (a named list).

See also

mixture_fit(), mixture_control()

Examples

mixture_prior()
#> Prior hyperparameters (bayesSampleMix)
#>   beta_scale  sigma_shape   sigma_rate    pi_shape1    pi_shape2    tau_shape 
#>           25            2            1            1            1            2 
#>     tau_rate      mu0_var     q_shape1     q_shape2 lambda_shape  lambda_rate 
#>            2          100            1            1            1            1 
mixture_prior(pi_shape1 = 2, pi_shape2 = 1)  # a priori favour compatibility
#> Prior hyperparameters (bayesSampleMix)
#>   beta_scale  sigma_shape   sigma_rate    pi_shape1    pi_shape2    tau_shape 
#>           25            2            1            2            1            2 
#>     tau_rate      mu0_var     q_shape1     q_shape2 lambda_shape  lambda_rate 
#>            2          100            1            1            1            1
